description: Ask Claude Sonnet 5 to write, review, summarize, translate or reason about text, paid per call with no API key. Pick quick, standard or long by how much text goes in and out. Price: from $0.034 per call, charged only on success. Price depends on length: quick $0.034, standard $0.133, long $0.330 (default quick). One call = one result.

length.description: quick: up to ~3,000 tokens in (about 10,000 characters) and ~750 words out. standard: ~12,000 in (40,000 characters) and ~3,000 words out. long: ~40,000 in (140,000 characters) and ~6,000 words out. Default quick

prompt.description: What you want Claude to do, with any text it needs

system.description: Optional instructions that frame every answer, e.g. 'You are a contracts lawyer. Answer in plain English.'

name: claude-sonnet-5
title: Claude Sonnet 5 text and review
